notes.title: Devlog 4 - Graphics & Music aka. Creating the Cozy Atmosphere
notes.notes:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120027/f8b5e393f9cff2d355b4ab7d2c1efb651d7f8501.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120027/6e14f508fe17f87e42b788dad8b086be2182f94c.png[/img][/url]
[h2]Hello again, fellow adventurers! [/h2]
Pilo here, ready to share about how the charming visuals and delightful music of my world came to life.

Fred aimed for my adventures to feel like wandering through a living painting, blending colorful, vibrant hand-painted worlds with simple, lovable characters like me. Each planet has a distinctive palette, ensuring each journey feels special and new, filled with optimism and warmth - even when exploring forgotten worlds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120027/b4e17efc2c4b5122c3a094deb835ab3ec68a4d7d.png[/img]

The animation was designed to match the gentle pace of exploration, from quietly browsing my Holobook to calmly wandering the desert. The cozy feeling extends into music, too, composed by Corentin.

He crafted music to mirror my adventures - optimistic, adventurous, yet thoughtful. With each new biome, the soundtrack evolves from cheerful orchestral themes into deeper, sometimes darker melodies, echoing my discoveries and growing understanding of my universe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120027/0f1c47f6414b4710aeee6a1d734f4dd48bafc864.gif[/img]

A favorite anecdote of mine involves early development, when the team created rough sketches directly in the game engine, letting me walk right on top of these giant paintings. They called it "playable concept art," and it made building the world feel playful and organic!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120027/e5552f610098158471dbf6ec9eb1377d6d1b20e9.png[/img]

And here's a fun fact: initially, all the characters sounded like Corentin making silly voices. Luckily, professional voice actors stepped in - but imagine how funny those early tests must have been!
Thanks for joining me on these behind-the-scenes adventures. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120027/47213f4d2766c4b8318961770df3ad65d84ba04c.png[/img]

See you in the game 💖

notes.title: Devlog 3 - About the Developers & Studio
notes.notes:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120027/ea99e985394fc3066530e9b88152367a4acd65ff.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120027/3e8741f6371f54c16ca306cb686f7667845ad406.png[/img][/url]
[h2]Hey, friends! [/h2]
It’s Pilo, and today, let's talk about the wonderful humans behind my world! 

Jérôme Bodin and Frédéric Simon dreamed me up together. Jérôme is a seasoned indie game veteran, and Frédéric’s artwork brought life to every corner of my cozy universe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120027/0f1c47f6414b4710aeee6a1d734f4dd48bafc864.gif[/img]

They started building my adventure in early 2022, and it took about three years of hard work. I heard they even had some tiring moments because building an entire cozy universe with just two people is no easy task! Thankfully, more talented friends joined later to help make things perfect.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120027/65dad807d159ba2f8140e2e0350f728350ff4e0c.png[/img]

One lovely lesson they learned was to trust their vision of creating something simply beautiful, free from action-packed drama. They say the best moment was seeing Jérôme’s young children enjoy exploring my world and collecting stickers together. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120027/e31b696a1eeabfe06fc3c6598f5d67e244a3f097.png[/img]

Jérôme’s godson even showed how magical my universe could be, skipping dialogues yet still having tons of fun. It was then my creators knew they had created a special place meant to be enjoyed by everyone -especially adults who still cherish the magic of childhood.

notes.title: Devlog 2: Level Design – Crafting the World of Pilo
notes.notes:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120027/dd4237ea8ef622f13c453f0c174bb96689d5731b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120027/e7ad9fc13800e242a68eb92d4feb26628f68f56f.png[/img][/url]
[h3]Hi, explorers! [/h3]

Pilo here again. Have you wondered how my worlds feel so relaxing and inviting to explore? It wasn't easy! My creators carefully designed each planet to feel uniquely enchanting and easy to wander around. They call this "revisitable," meaning you can come back again and again to uncover new surprises, helped by Professor’s special gadgets!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120027/e5552f610098158471dbf6ec9eb1377d6d1b20e9.png[/img]

Though puzzles exist here and there, they are more about tickling your curiosity than challenging your mind too harshly. One planet in particular - the swampy one - was especially tricky. It was too dark at first, almost impossible to explore! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120027/dcfff3ef912801e3578105dbca498adde96f1b84.gif[/img]

But after some careful tinkering, it's now mysterious yet inviting, just like the "Mysterious Ecosystem," my personal favorite area. It perfectly captures the wonder and peace of adventure.


Keep an eye out - there might be sweet surprises for a little explorer with a sweet tooth like me 🍰✨

notes.title: Devlog 1: Why Cozy Puzzle with Collecting Stickers?
notes.notes:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120027/60e2211dcdfa1a348ba7e628a97eb2331348f88a.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120027/dfad6df37cd8fc819ea2952babf8eccd3f58dd87.png[/img][/url]
[h3]Hi! I'm Pilo, [/h3]
and today, I want to tell you about how my cozy world came to be. It all began when Fred (Frédéric Simon, our amazing Art Director) sketched an imaginary observatory - my first glimpse into the beautiful universe I'd soon explore. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120027/906817d64c2e9d8062b5cf9901d98a672f1a5c85.gif[/img]

He originally thought about making a fantasy art book, but soon, everyone realized how wonderful it would be to actually step inside this cozy, mysterious world through my eyes! And here I am, a curious little adventurer on a charming journey, and guess what? It's full of stickers!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120027/b9a717c26960b9bfa4c27c497c55dd3b3ff4c76f.gif[/img]

You might wonder, why stickers? Well, they're fun, remind us of childhood, and it's pretty cool to collect and stick them into my beloved Holobook. Stickers aren't just fun collectibles; they're how I capture memories, simplify my discoveries, and share my adventures with you. 

My world isn't about solving tough puzzles - it's about taking your time, observing closely, and savoring every little wonder around you. Exploration itself is the biggest reward!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120027/e38fa7c545702353ee918b3345f12efe23df4880.gif[/img]

Oh, and here's a tiny secret: there's a sticker of me hidden somewhere. But without a selfie option, how could I have managed that? I'll let you figure that out!

notes.title: New Demo Patch Notes!
notes.notes:
Hello space explorers!

For those of you who have played the previous version of Pilo and the Holobook’s demo, a bit more adventure awaits you in this new Steam Next Fest version!

[b]Here’s what changed from the previous version:[/b]
[list]
[*] One of the planets from the full game is now included. It's a desert planet in which you'll have to solve several puzzles, adding around half an hour of gameplay to the demo. That’s plenty of new stickers, dialogues, and visuals for ya!
[*] New music, new sounds - they’re quite sandy!
[*] Polished art, fixed bugs 🐜
[*] Following feedback from the community, Pilo is now faster 🏃‍♂️💨
[/list]

Have fun playing the new version of the demo and see you soon, space explorers 🚀

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120027/e38fa7c545702353ee918b3345f12efe23df4880.gif[/img]

notes.title: Visit Pilo and the Holobook on Steam Space Exploration Fest!
notes.notes:
[h2] For all of the fans of experiencing coozy space adventures... We have a great news! Pilo and the Holobook participates in Steam Space Exploration Fest! Play the demo now! [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120027/565123a76dd102b2c4763bef84222e6d4516ec81.jpg[/img]

Cataloging this colorful universe with Pilo and the Holobook 🌟

The new world has many secrets to discover – together with Pilo and Prof, players will traverse it and create its first encyclopedia! To record data about something they’ll have to take a picture of it and turn it into a sticker, which will then appear in the Holobook. Exploring planets, meeting new friends, forging bonds, and doing some adorable space travel is mandatory while cataloging the universe. This will be an incredible adventure! 🎒

At this moment, Pilo and the Holobook’s demo version is available on Steam and it has quite a few items to catalog. There will be plenty of new discoveries to make in the full version of the game! 🎮

notes.title: Tiny Teams 2024
notes.notes:
[b]The team behind Pilo and the Holobook is proud to be part of Tiny Teams 2024, an event on and off Steam that puts a light on solo or micro dev team.[/b]

As you may know we have crafted most of the game as a 2-person workforce, so we're very much fitting the criteria! As the production comes to an end, a few more are going to join the adventure. Can't wait to show you all what we cautiously cooked! 

Meanwhile, you'll be able to watch content creators play Pilo and other games over at Tiny Teams 2024: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/TinyTeams2024]https://store.steampowered.com/sale/TinyTeams2024[/url]

Enjoy and have a great summer!
